def export_pdf(rows, path):
    """Export rows to a simple PDF file without external dependencies."""
    # Simple PDF generation without reportlab
    # PDF structure based on the minimal PDF specification
    
    lines = []
    for row in rows:
        lines.append(", ".join(str(cell) for cell in row))
    
    text_content = "\n".join(lines)
    
    # Build a minimal valid PDF
    pdf_objects = []
    
    # Object 1: Catalog
    pdf_objects.append("1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj")
    
    # Object 2: Pages
    # Calculate number of pages needed (approximately 50 lines per page)
    lines_per_page = 50
    num_pages = max(1, (len(lines) + lines_per_page - 1) // lines_per_page) if lines else 1
    page_refs = " ".join(f"{i + 3} 0 R" for i in range(num_pages))
    pdf_objects.append(f"2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [ {page_refs} ] /Count {num_pages} >>\nendobj")
    
    # Create pages and their content
    obj_num = 3
    for page_idx in range(num_pages):
        start_line = page_idx * lines_per_page
        end_line = min(start_line + lines_per_page, len(lines))
        page_lines = lines[start_line:end_line]
        
        # Page object
        content_obj_num = obj_num + 1
        pdf_objects.append(f"{obj_num} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents {content_obj_num} 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 {3 + num_pages * 2} 0 R >> >> >>\nendobj")
        obj_num += 1
        
        # Content stream
        stream_content = "BT\n/F1 12 Tf\n"
        y = 750
        for line in page_lines:
            # Escape special characters in PDF strings
            escaped_line = line.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
            stream_content += f"50 {y} Td\n({escaped_line}) Tj\n-50 -{y} Td\n"

        pdf_objects.append(f"{obj_num} 0 obj\n<< /Length {len(stream_content)} >>\nstream\n{stream_content}\nendstream\nendobj")
        obj_num += 1

    font_obj_num = obj_num
    pdf_objects.append(f"{font_obj_num} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>\nendobj")
    obj_num += 1
    
    # Build the PDF

        offsets.append(len(pdf_content))
        pdf_content += obj + "\n"

    pdf_content += f"xref\n0 {obj_num}\n"
    pdf_content += "0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for offset in offsets:
